build_linear_layer: build a generalized linear layer from input and output axis specifications with Xavier uniform initialization
create_affine_layer: create an affine layer combining a linear operator and a learnable bias with configurable initializers
build_named_einsum: build a named einsum layer that contracts tensors based on axis names instead of positional indices
create_add_bias: create an add bias layer that applies a learnable offset across specified named axes
build_rename_axes: build a rename axes layer that renames specified axis names on a named array
